findings.highlight: No can do. We’re fasting today.
findings.evidenceJa: だめでござる。今日は断食するでござる
findings.governingReading: Shirou improvises an exaggerated samurai register by repeating ござる.
findings.explanation: The English supplies casual slang but removes the period-role performance that launches the joke.

findings.highlight: Provisions exhausted, ready for my last stand.
findings.evidenceJa: 兵糧既に尽き背水の河氾濫せり
findings.governingReading: The mock-military proclamation says the provisions are gone and the river at their backs has flooded.
findings.explanation: Last stand replaces the absurd flooded-river escalation with a generic military cliché.

findings.evidenceJa: 朝はハンバーグだった
findings.explanation: Hamburgers again changes the plated Japanese dish into sandwiches.

findings.evidenceJa: 話はまったく、一手たりとも進んでいません
findings.governingReading: Saber protests that the discussion has not advanced by even a single move.
findings.explanation: Not finished loses her complaint that Shirou has made literally no argumentative progress and removes the tactical metaphor.

findings.highlight: the growling of the stomach is caused by movements of stomach called hunger contraction
findings.evidenceJa: 腹の虫は飢餓収縮と呼ばれる胃腸の動きが原因である
findings.governingReading: The narration attributes stomach growling to gastrointestinal movement called hunger contraction.
findings.explanation: The English omits required articles and agreement, making the pseudo-physiological explanation grammatically malformed.

findings.highlight: happy that she was able to disparage Saber
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーを遣り込めたのが嬉しい
findings.governingReading: Illya is delighted that she managed to get the better of Saber in the exchange.
findings.explanation: Disparage recasts her victory in the argument as merely speaking slightingly about Saber.

findings.highlight: Saber can only create enough magical energy to keep herself alive.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーが一日で作れる魔力は、一日の存在に必要な量に満たない
findings.governingReading: The magical energy Saber can generate in one day is insufficient for the amount required to exist for that day.
findings.explanation: Enough reverses the deficit into sufficiency, undermining the reason she must conserve and supplement energy.

findings.highlight: in life, you should take simple precautions or the wounds will last forever
findings.evidenceJa: 人生注意一秒怪我一生
findings.governingReading: The line twists the compact safety slogan “one second of caution, a lifetime of injury.”
findings.explanation: The explanatory paraphrase loses the balanced slogan form and its recognizable comic mechanism.

findings.governingReading: The false choice offers membership in Tocker, a tiger-themed evil-organization parody name.
findings.explanation: The Tigers removes the coined organization name and most of the tokusatsu parody signal.

findings.evidenceJa: 怒るととことんまでやり返してくる
findings.governingReading: Shirou concludes that when Saber is angry, she retaliates and gets even all the way.
findings.explanation: Retort confines her violent physical payback to a verbal reply and is nonidiomatic with thoroughly.
